## About Me

I am a political scientist in Human Rights and Political Science at [Wilfrid Laurier University](http://www.wlu.ca). My primary interests are in the fields of political communication, public opinion and political parties. I am originally from Edmonton, Alberta, and did my undergraduate degree in Political Science at the [University of Alberta](http://www.ualberta.ca). After some time in Germany, including a fascinating internship at the [German Bundestag](http://www.bundestag.de/en), the [Canadian embassy](https://www.international.gc.ca/country-pays/germany-allemagne/index.aspx?lang=eng) and a leading national [television political talk show,](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sabine_Christiansen_(TV_program)) I returned to Kingston, Ontario to do my graduate work. I obtained my PhD from [Queen's University](http://www.queensu.ca) in 2008 and then moved back to Germany to do my post-doctoral work at the [John F. Kennedy Institute for North American Studies](https://www.jfki.fu-berlin.de/en/index.html).

```{r}
#| echo: false

find_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  dir <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = FALSE)
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_quarto.yml"))) {
    parent <- dirname(dir)
    if (identical(parent, dir)) stop("Could not locate _quarto.yml")
    dir <- parent
  }
  dir
}
source(file.path(find_root(), "R_scripts", "project_listings.R"))
render_recent_pubs(3)
```
